description: Add React Three Fiber (R3F) as a 3D/2.5D rendering tier alongside React-Konva, rewrite The Abyssal Well in R3F as proof of concept and exemplar, add a stack-selection decision gate to the game creation workflow, and brainstorm/seed R3F game candidates.
deviation_notes: Phase S2 user verification found the original game rules contradictory (breach damage + in-order shooting + highlighted target leaking the answer). Story S5 added: cycling words, mistake-based lives, continuous smooth rotation. Implementation/docs for S3/S4 and S5 gameplay are complete; remaining gates are user manual verification for S2/S3/S4/S5 and a full hydrated browser/canvas smoke for S5 after local browser automation is available. Story S6 added 2026-07-08: retheme The Abyssal Well from primitive geometry to the KayKit 3D house family (Dungeon Remastered + Skeletons + Adventurers + RPG Tools + Character Animations) to prove the GLB-asset pipeline; creature types swap to skeleton variants so no custom models are required. S6 is blocked on KayKit pack files landing in public/assets/3d/kaykit/ (see kaykit-asset-shopping-list.md). CANCELLED by user on 2026-07-10. S1 fully complete (R3F stack adoption). S2/S3/S4/S5: implementation/docs complete but user manual verification never performed. S6 blocked and unstarted. Spec preserved; implementation code not retained.

sprint.goal: Establish React Three Fiber as a production-ready 3D/2.5D rendering tier alongside React-Konva, proven by a fully compliant R3F rewrite of The Abyssal Well, with a documented stack-selection decision gate in the game creation workflow and a seeded pipeline of 3D game candidates.
